chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a man who fiddles with his private part during the obligatory salat (prayer), and he said: There is no harm in it.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is not objectionable in this ruling
key_terms.يَعْبَثُ: to fiddle or toy with repeatedly

ai.seo_question: Does touching one's private part during obligatory salat (prayer) invalidate the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning touching or fiddling with the private part during the obligatory salat (prayer). Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that there is no harm in it, indicating that this act does not in itself invalidate the prayer.
